Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::chooseOneForReview(requestid: Integer): LoanRequest {
	definition:
		r: LoanRequest = currentLoanRequests->any(l|l.requestID = requestID)
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequests->exists(l|l.requestID = requestID)
	postcondition:
		r.oclIsUndefined() or
		(currentLoanRequest = r and
		LoanRequest.allInstance()->includes(currentLoanRequest))
}
